_doc: Detailed notes of the units (coarse-graining skill): draft (writer) -> check (independent checker, prints a
report ending in 'Verdict: PASS' or 'Verdict: REVISE') -> edit (writer settles every finding against the Lean,
writes response.md) -> confirm (the checker again, on the edited notes) -> status (STATUS = EDITED if the
confirmation passes, else COMPARED).
Driver: rollout.py of the writing-workflow skill (field table in its references/driver.md). The driver requires
that a reviewer and the preceding writer come from different model families: here the example profiles 'writer'
and 'reviewer' belong to different families. To draft with a cheaper model, add a profile to your agents.json and
keep the checker in the other family. The published status (draft, compared, edited) is set from the rounds a
unit completed, with the meanings in references/unit-outlines.md: <this run's workdir>/<unit>/STATUS lowercased
once the status stage has run, draft before. The condensed outlines (rollout.compress.example.json) run in a
workdir of their own, whose <unit>/STATUS holds the fidelity verdict (FAITHFUL or ISSUES), so that it never
overwrites this one.
Inputs to prepare in the map directory: inventories/<unit>.md, written by inventory.py (size, results by mass
with statement excerpts, definitions, inputs from other units); statement.md, the statement page written in
phase 0 of the campaign (lean-to-manuscript) in the format of honest-publication's
assets/statement-page.template.md; architecture.md and glossary.md; lean-links.tsv (lean_links.py --all-used);
declaration-units.tsv and units.tsv (unit_tables.py).
Use: copy this file next to your work (or keep it here and pass --workdir), replace every SET-ME value, run
rollout.py rollout.outlines.example.json --dry-run, then without --dry-run; pilot two units first (--only).
Unit entries: outline_budget.py --units-tsv units.tsv --emit-units-json prints title, pages and the variables.
The two units are Yang-Mills units, as an example.
workdir: SET-ME: working directory for the outline stages (outside the skills repository)

vars.project: SET-ME: one line naming the formal result, e.g. OpenAI's Lean proof of the construction of four-dimensional quantum Yang-Mills theory
vars.lean_root: SET-ME: the Lean source checked out at the pinned commit (read-only)
vars.map: SET-ME: the map directory: graph.sqlite, lean-links.tsv, declaration-units.tsv, units.tsv, architecture.md, glossary.md, statement.md (phase 0 statement page), inventories/<unit>.md (inventory.py)
